filters.name: lowercase a to z only
filters.rule: every letter is a to z

filters.name: reserved words
filters.rule: not zz, fn, run, or a number word zero to nine

filters.name: edit distance
filters.rule: Levenshtein distance at least 3 from every word kept before it, in length then alphabetical order

filters.name: prime size
filters.rule: keep the first N words, N the largest prime not above the count
